card.architecture: MiniMax-H3 fl2va (Qwen3-VL 32B, int8 ConvRot) — REFERENCE-TO-VIDEO with native audio
card.summary: Generate a clip whose SUBJECT is taken from your reference image(s), with NATIVE stereo audio — voice, sound effects and music generated together with the motion. The current image is the primary subject reference; add more via the ＋ ref picker. The references condition identity/appearance (they are NOT the first frame). Output is an mp4 with a baked-in audio track.
use_cases: reference→video: place a referenced subject into a new clip with synchronized sound
multi-reference identity (subject from several angles / a few characters)
generate motion + audio around a subject without pinning a first frame
card.pick_when: You want a NEW clip featuring the subject from your reference image(s) — not to animate the current picture as its literal first frame (use MiniMax-H3 image→video for that).

prompt.guidance: Describe the SCENE and MOTION you want built around the referenced subject, then add an 'Audio:' line; the references define the subject's appearance/identity.
prompt.example: she walks through a neon-lit street at night, looking around, hair moving as she turns. Slow tracking shot alongside her. Audio: distant city traffic, footsteps on wet pavement, a moody synth line.
prompt.overview: The reference image(s) define WHO/WHAT appears — describe the setting, action and camera, not the subject's static appearance, then add an 'Audio:' line so H3 generates the soundtrack (ambience, effects, dialogue, score) jointly with the motion.
prompt.instructions: Describe the scene and the subject's action using concrete verbs with explicit speed and direction, specify a distinct camera move, and add atmosphere. Then add an 'Audio:' section describing ambience, timed sound effects, any dialogue, and score. Don't re-describe the referenced subject's static appearance (the references define it). Quote spoken lines. Timeline cues like [0s-2s] help place motion and audio beats.
do: Describe the scene/setting the subject is placed into
Lead the subject's action with concrete verbs (speed + direction)
Specify a camera move (slow push-in, dolly out, pan, orbit, static)
Add an explicit 'Audio:' line: ambience, timed effects, dialogue, score
Quote spoken lines; use [0s-2s] cues to time beats
dont: Don't re-describe the referenced subject's static appearance (the references define it)
Don't rely on negative prompts — this is a distilled model
Don't forget the audio: leaving it out wastes H3's main capability
examples: The referenced woman walks slowly toward the camera across a sunlit plaza, glancing to her side. Steady dolly-back keeping her centered, shallow depth of field, warm afternoon light. Audio: soft crowd murmur, distant fountain, a gentle acoustic guitar motif.

speed.measured_note: large video model with a 32B text encoder; reference tokens ride every sampling step. Not yet benchmarked on this box.

ui_help.note: Generate a clip WITH sound featuring the subject from your reference image(s). Describe the scene, motion and audio.

edit_use_cases: reference-to-video: generate a clip featuring the referenced subject, with native audio

reference.hint: The current image is the primary subject reference; add more subject references here. Describe the scene and motion — the references define the subject's appearance.
